description: Fast, Secure, Living Data for Enterprise Decisions Flexa Tables is a Power BI visual add-on that greatly extends the capability of Power BI. It delivers enterprise-level savings by eliminating wasteful steps and unnecessary friction in the data analytics workflow. Flexa Tables puts data ownership into the hands of the business user and gives them full access to the data. It can dramatically reduce their dependence on IT support by providing simple tools to perform their own deep dive investigations quickly and intuitively. The DIY user interface is familiar and super user-friendly, delivering immediate productivity while eliminating the need for complex queries by support teams. No more exporting to Excel – Pivot table functionality built in. Access all columns in the source data, not what IT thinks you need. Unlock a potential gold mine of new findings by empowering all data consumers. End users of published Power BI reports now have the power to work with the data: Quick Variance Calculations: Built-in Variance Function delivers instant variance insights with percentage, ratios and value differences, paired with dynamic visual charts. Pivot like Excel: Enable viewers and developers to pivot data and create custom views independently for troubleshooting or business insights after reports are published. Unlock All Hidden Data: Access all columns in the original data source,…
